metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the IGES tool under [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) with supporting modules in [output/iges_tool](/workspace/output/iges_tool). It supports `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, emits the required diagnostic JSON envelope on invalid input, reads/writes fixed-format 80-column IGES, builds canonical JSON, validates the required Global/DE conditions, and includes evaluators for the contract’s curve and surface entity set with transformation-matrix application.

I smoke-tested `write -> parse -> query -> eval -> roundtrip` on synthetic line and analytic-surface cases, and verified that a second roundtrip over generated output is byte-identical to the first. I did not run it against an external real-world CAD corpus in this workspace, so broader compatibility beyond the implemented smoke cases is unverified.
